Abilities: It allows the user to create identical existences to themself by splitting their consciousness, referred to asother bodies｢別身体,betsu shintai｣.[1]

UnlikeBody Doubles, eachbodycreated has asoulof their own identical to the user's, making them fully autonomous creatures who can act independently. As a result, each other body can be considered the main body and will continue to exist even after the original body of the user dies. All the bodies are connected to each other throughsoul corridors, allowing for instantaneous and discreet communication regardless of distance; if the user is proficient enough, they can even share each other's senses in real time. In addition, all the other bodies have full and unrestricted access to all of the user'sskills, includinguniqueand evenultimate skills.[2][3][4][5]

The only notable drawback of the skill is how many other bodies can be active at once while sparingenergyfor other purposes. For each other body created, 10% of the user's maximum energy is used as a collateral, an energy maintenance cost that is subtracted from the user's energy capacity. Since all the other bodies are connected to the main body through soul corridors, they are essentially sharing the same energy capacity and can supply each other; the only limit is that the maximum energy of all the bodies combined is limited to the maximum energy capacity of the user, minus the collaterals. The collateral will also return to the user upon undoing the other bodies, though the returned collateral may be reduced, based on the damage sustained by the other bodies; if said other body is destroyed, this energy is lost and must be recovered normally.[1][2][6]

The user can also create "partial" other bodies, which are often referred to as "body doubles" because they are extremely similar to the copies created by Body Double; they do not have souls of their own, and therefore cannot be considered the main body and have to be remotely controlled by the user. Unlike the copies created by Body Double however, these so-called body doubles are still connected to the main body and each other through soul corridors, allowing the user to share the same energy capacity as well as use their unique and ultimate skills through them regardless of their distance from the main body. They have either a negligible energy maintenance cost or none at all.[6][7][8]

This skill is incredibly difficult to use and the only one that is able to use it perfectly is its creator Velgrynd. EvenVeldoraandRimuruare said to not be capable of using it to its full potential andSoueineeds to entrust hisheart coreto Benimaru, borrowing his power to pilot the other bodies at distant locations.[9]

The abilities they offer their user are varied and different from skill to skill, even skills with similar abilities or names will operate under completely different mechanisms and result in differences in performance.[2]Of those who awaken unique skills, only around 10% of them possess powers that have an apparent utility in combat.[3]

While unique skills are useful abilities that are perfectly suited to their users, very few are ever able to unleash the true power of them. Those that ignore that unique skills are mirrors into their minds and neglect that significance, only ever seeing them as useful tools or weapons to be used, will never manage to bring out their full potential.[2]

Unique skills are capable of being rooted in the user's body or being rooted within their soul. Regardless of where it is located, possessing a unique skill is said to offer its user a certain level of resistance or immunity to lower-level abilities, even the effects of other unique skills. The ones rooted in thesoulin particular offer a high level of protection, especially against abilities that affect the mind such asTyrant,Greed, andChosen One.[4][5]In the most extreme cases, it is possible for a soul-rooted unique skill to act as a replacement housing for consciousness in place of the soul.[6][7]

Due to their nature as the shape of their user's mind, unique skills will grow and change as they themselves develop and mature.[2][8]For example, Hinata's unique skillUsurperoriginally bore the name "Robber"[9]when she acquired it, and it later changed to "Surpasser"[10]after finding out the truth behind Luminism and undergoing the Trial of theSeven Luminaries. The pinnacle of this phenomenon is the birth of anultimate skill, which is the result of a soul-rooted unique skill being nurtured with strong emotions and energy over a period of time, along with various other unknown conditions, to crystallize into the ultimate power.[11]
